payout_value_note: Flat $100 credited to the referrer's checking account per qualifying business checking referral; business friend earns $100 too. No annual cap (unlimited referrals/rewards).
payout_quote: Invite A Business is a referral program that rewards you with $100 (credited to your checking account) for every business you refer who opens a qualified business checking account and completes the required actions. Your business friend benefits too – they also earn $100 (credited to their checking account).
numeric_basis: payout from official refer.centier.com FAQ ('$100 (credited to your checking account) for every business you refer'); time: referral share signup + link sharing est. 5-15 min active
eligibility: Centier Bank clients 18+; referred business must not have an active business checking account with Centier nor have had one in the last 12 months.
steps: Visit centier.com/invite-a-business and sign up with your information to get your unique share link
Invite businesses via text, email, or Facebook using your link
Business clicks the link, signs up, opens a qualified business checking account, and signs up for Online Banking within 90 days
$100 reward deposited to both referrer's and business friend's checking accounts within 90 days of account opening

Reward deposited 'within 90 days of account opening' — payout is not immediate
Money Market accounts are not included

when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Referral link signup and sharing takes ~10 minutes active; the $100 reward is deposited to the referrer's checking account within 90 days of the business's account opening. — structural: a 90-day account-open/seasoning requirement must elapse before payout.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
Volume constraint noted in terms: cap stated: 'You can invite an unlimited number of businesses! — plan referral count against the cap, not the calendar.
